notes: Translated by tools/import_force.py --negative from SolidLabResearch/ODRL-Test-Suite@7958238 data/policies/policy-1.ttl and its 3 test cases; FORCE: "Everybody can do everything." FORCE reads an absent action and target as "any". ODRL 2.2 does not: a Permission and a Prohibition MUST have one action and one target (IM 2.6.1, 2.6.2), so the policy is not ODRL 2.2 and fails odrl22-shape.ttl. due2 rejects it rather than guess the reading (architecture §1); "everyone, everything" is the enforcement point's default, or an explicit asset collection. The test cases are kept, with FORCE's results, in force_expected; due2 evaluates none of them. Upstream defect, reported before (conformance/external/README.md).
